verdict.rationale: Marqeta's own docs clearly cover Gateway just-in-time funding, where the customer's system receives funding requests and approves or denies each one using its own business rules. Nothing in the pack shows a prefunded-balance funding model as a selectable alternative, or any documentation of cash-flow tradeoffs between the two. missing for 10: documented prefunded/program-funding option as an explicit choice, documentation of cash-flow tradeoffs between prefunded and JIT funding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented

citations.quote: The Marqeta platform enables you to fund accounts at transaction time using your system to make funding decisions. Your system receives funding requests and approves or denies them using your own business rules.
